The supporting claims are the three observations, the caveat, and the definitions; the scope conditions—repeatability under the recorded conditions, a declared workload, and specified rules—are essential. No qualification is premature or repeated. The difficulty is conceptual rather than structural, and the concrete-to-abstract order plus short sentences make it manageable; reordering would likely separate the observations from the taxonomy that explains them.
